criteria.rubric: A separate Go module constructs and exercises the runtime without CLI imports, flags, terminal state or hidden global initialization.

Services expose thin services/X contracts with private services/X/internal implementations and per-service Wire construction. The legacy agent-cli/internal/services/internal/agentruntime production package is fully deprecated: all production callers use service-owned contracts and transport integrations, and the package contains no business policy, reusable runtime behavior, composition ownership, or device/audio implementation. Any temporary compatibility symbols are explicit Deprecated: aliases or thin adapters with no independent decisions or mutable state. CLI packages own only presentation, argument/input adaptation, and transport integration into those services.
Correlated device capture/playback, provider send/receive, tool lifecycle, cancellation, queues/drops and terminal evidence use explicit timing domains and bounded recording resources.
Credential-free replay preserves recorded audio packets, ordering, tool events, interruption and termination; hardware and external nondeterminism limits are explicit.

Truncated/no playback, barge-in failure, long-conversation slowdown and tool-continuation collisions have reproducible characterization, fixes where demonstrated, and exact residual limitations without false completion claims.

Architecture boundaries, package/file/function size, complexity, mutable globals, generated Wire consistency and relevant compile/static/race checks pass without growing migration baselines or weakening assertions.

Supported CLI behavior is preserved and final integrated behavior has fresh independent customer and engineering evidence, with authorized bounded Realtime proof and explicit physical-device evidence limits.

payload.mission: Fresh independent Luna engineering validation of reviewed PR439, guarded-merged as d5d6f843 after all nine exact-head CI checks passed. Verify the immutable YUI and source-archive hashes before and after; never rebuild or substitute the executable. Extract the source archive only into probe-owned storage and confirm its Git-tree provenance. Launch the staged shipped YUI and exercise C47's changed public workflow: run the credential-free recorded audio/tool replay and the shipped WebMCP composite target-selection workflow using the committed fixtures/recipes. Require the exact tool marker and continuation, exact provider/rendered PCM effects, bounded stdout/stderr and disk, explicit terminal evidence, exit zero, and no process-group survivors. Reproduce the high-rate tool/audio regression with the unchanged every-sample oracle and require complete playback with no unexplained 6,400-sample loss; reported zero drops/overflows/discards cannot substitute for rendered PCM. Exercise the C47 low-output-budget and forced-timeout negative controls from the exact source: they must fail closed before or during launch for the intended cause, preserve the first causal error, cap aggregate output, terminate/reap the whole process group, and leave no survivors. Recheck an existing interruption plus ordinary audio/tool replay workflow for regression and clean shutdown. Inspect the WebMCP normalization source to confirm bare and browserID/targetID selections succeed while a genuinely unrelated restored target remains fail-closed; source tests are supplemental and cannot replace launching the shipped program. Record exact commands, exits, output/effects, hashes and limitations. Process smoke and software replay are not physical/acoustic proof; native Windows hardware/endpoints and physical acoustic testing are OUT OF SCOPE under the recorded amendment, never PASS. Missing software prerequisites are BLOCKED. ACCEPTED applies only to C47 and does not close any broad project criterion.
